# Birchtech Secures Granular Activated Carbon Supply Agreement with High-Grade Activated Carbon Producer


November 23, 2026 8:31am EST


*Planned Production Capability Expansion, up to 10,000 Tons Per Year, Expected to Support Capital-Light Approach to Becoming a Leading Water Treatment GAC Supplier*


CORSICANA, Texas, Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Birchtech Corp. (NYSE American: BCHT) (TSX: BCHT) (“Birchtech” or the “Company”), a leader in specialty activated carbon technologies for sustainable air and water treatment, today announced a high-grade granular activated carbon (GAC) supply agreement with a preferred activated carbon producer, positioning Birchtech to become a leading supplier of GAC for the treatment of drinking water nationally.


Under the agreement, Birchtech is expected to source high-grade GAC, produced for the treatment of drinking water treatment, to supply water utilities beginning in early 2027, at an initial 2,000 tons per year. Planned capacity expansions at the partner’s production facility are expected to increase available volume to up to 10,000 tons per year by approximately 2030.


This new agreement, which supersedes the Company's previously announced October 2024 feedstock supply agreement, supports Birchtech’s complete water treatment offering. This includes Rapid Small-Scale Column Testing (RSSCT) for media selection, GAC supply, media changeout services and, in the future, carbon reactivation through the Company’s proprietary Carbon Rejuvenation® process. As active members of national water industry groups, including the American Water Works Association (AWWA), National Rural Water Association (NRWA), and Rural Water Associations for several states, Birchtech is focused on serving utilities of all sizes across the vast water industry.


**Management Commentary**


Richard MacPherson, Chief Executive Officer of Birchtech, said: “Demand for granular activated carbon is expected to grow significantly as more than 66,000 U.S. public water systems monitor for PFAS under the EPA’s drinking water rule.


“This agreement gives Birchtech a clear path to scale our water business without the capital expenditures required to build a GAC manufacturing facility, allowing us to focus on direct sales efforts to established water utility relationships in the near-term, all with the confidence of a robust supply chain backing up our national sales efforts. As demand for GAC continues to grow amidst a tight supply environment, we are well positioned to deliver highly effective, affordable treatment solutions, across the water treatment industry,” concluded MacPherson.


**About Birchtech Corp.**


Birchtech Corp. (NYSE American: BCHT) (TSX: BCHT) is a leader in specialty activated carbon technologies delivering innovative solutions for air and water purification to support a cleaner, more sustainable future. The Company provides patented SEA® sorbent technologies for mercury emissions capture for the coal-fired utility sector and SEA disruptive water purification technologies with a specialization on removing contaminants, including ‘forever chemicals’ such as PFAS, from potable water and industrial wastewater. Backed by a strong intellectual property portfolio and a team of activated carbon experts, Birchtech provides cleaner air to North American communities and is applying this expertise to a novel approach in water purification. To learn more, please visit[www.birchtech.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=s-QlAPD3q37fypWOw_yncvMyKC-Sjx9JxgWhitKhIrcwnBVIgCHURdYnDUo9wwD7GCyXIUM0v1rTVdbU8D0ECBKjLSsIPJZhp015cDiLQ0w=) .
